title: Why quantum computing will break cryptocurrency by 2030

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Quantum computing will break elliptic curve cryptography by 2030, rendering most cryptocurrencies insecure. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Shor's algorithm can factor large primes in polynomial time, directly breaking RSA and ECDSA used in blockchain. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Post-quantum cryptography like lattice-based schemes are already being standardized by NIST and integrated into protocols. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Adoption is slow—only 1% of blockchain networks use quantum-resistant algorithms, leaving the majority exposed. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Quantum resistance is inevitable—cryptocurrencies that adapt will survive; those that don’t will collapse. (4 sec)
